backend_scope: Sentence readouts RTX3080, terminal readouts A100; no online time or ARC conclusion
evaluation: 256 observed development questions, 128 ProofWriter + 128 LogiQA2; question-weighted metrics; no fresh question text, fresh gold, ARC or confirmation access
metrics: 64-token conditional band AUROC and AP; pooled within-band AUROC
1000 paired material-group bootstrap replicates (seed20261012), stratified by dataset, same sampled groups for each controller
Threshold-sweep fixed-trajectory replay at uniform absolute sentence ordinal s mod4=0; thresholds [0,.1,.25,.5,.75,.9,1], fixed stopping entropy .85, with .70 supplementary
models: Frozen current task-agnostic hidden-state + position trigger (.85 target)
Position-only logistic, refit from scratch C=.01 solver=lbfgs max_iter=3000 tol=1e-7; position=prefix_tokens/1024
Training-fitted fixed 64-token position lookup (16 bins), weighted target mean with Laplace 1 numerator / 2 denominator smoothing
primary_target: sentence readout correct AND normalized entropy certainty >= .85
replay: All learned schedules and every4 share full-development absolute sentence checkpoints. Train sampled-event list indices never used as sentence ordinal. Coalesce same observable time by latest complete prefix; exclude observable time >= terminal. Charge terminal fallback query. Replay is original fixed-trajectory counterfactual analysis, not online latency measurement.
secondary_target: correct AND entropy certainty >= .70; score the same .85-trained controllers without refitting or selection
selection: Diagnostic controllers saved only here; no change to main controller, training, protocol, existing result or online code
training: 1024 existing train questions; frozen OOF sentence readouts, original normalized per-question training_weight
